readme:
# dsh-web-hero-patch

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web-surface
plugin: a hero character image tucked behind the composer input plus a lifted
headline — the "everything is a plugin" way to dress up the new-session hero.

## What it does

In the new-session hero state of the Web GUI:

- renders `assets/deepseek_smile.png` above the composer input, tucked slightly
  behind the input card (layer relationship: input bar in front, character
  behind), with a soft silhouette drop shadow;
- keeps the workspace / mode row right above the input bar, floating over the
  image's lower area;
- lifts the headline ("探索未至之境" / "Into the Unknown") 52px up.

## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): registers a `/hero-image/` prefix route on the
  DSH webser
